policy_presence.summary: Sydney has formal assessment and academic integrity rules with student AI guidance updated June 2026.

coursework.summary: AI allowed in open assessments with acknowledgement; generally prohibited in secure assessments unless expressly permitted.

exams.summary: Secure assessments generally prohibit AI unless the unit coordinator expressly permits it.

ai_disclosure.summary: Acknowledgement of AI use is required (tool, version, publisher, URL, use); HDR theses need an AI statement.

privacy_data_entry.summary: No confidential, personal, proprietary or course materials in AI tools.

academic_integrity.summary: AI misuse is a breach; Turnitin AI score is not sole evidence; tiered investigation.

approved_tools.summary: Copilot free for students; Cogniti via units; Harvey AI for Law students; ChatGPT Edu planned (pilot Oct 2026, all students S1 2027).

named_ai_services.summary: Named services with distinct audiences and rollout status.

teaching_guidance.summary: Two-lane assessment design and coordinator responsibility to specify AI rules.

research_guidance.summary: HDR students: spelling/grammar help only unless AI is integral to approved methodology; thesis AI statement required.

security_procurement.summary: Data guardrails exist; a general AI procurement/security review process was not reviewed.
